 Mechatronics & Robotics Technician   –   JLL   
 What this job involves:    
 As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and   maintaining   material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install,   maintain   and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will have the opportunity to mentor junior technicians to   grow in   their roles.    
 What your day-to-day will look like:   
 Promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures   
 Complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation   
 Troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more   
 Maintain a positive working relationship across all the Operations facility   
 Track and store department inventory   
 Move up to 49lbs as well as stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, with or without reasonable accommodation   
 Possible travel   up to 20% at a minimum.   
 Required Qualifications:   
 High school diploma or equivalent   
 Ability to work flexible schedules/shifts/areas, including weekends,   nights   and/or holidays   
 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment   
 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures   
 Preferred Qualifications:   
 Associates or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus in the Mechanical or Electrical field   
 2+ years of experience with automated conveyor systems and controls   
 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading   
 1+ year of knowledge with electrical and electronic principles   
 Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards   
 Experience with a Computerized Maintenance Management System (CMMS)   
 Experience with robotic or electromechanical operation and maintenance   
 Able to troubleshoot basic input and output functions   
 Physical Demands   
 Repetitive bending, crouching, kneeling, reaching, twisting, sitting, standing, and walking   
 Lifting parts and tools weighing on average 20 pounds, occasionally weighing up to 49 pounds   
 Dexterity in eye/hand coordination, feet (foot pedals) manual (picking, pinching, holding, grasping), and wrist motion (repetitive flexion/rotation)   
 Working conditions may include small spaces, dust, fumes/odors, hot/cold temperatures, inside/outside noise, vibration, standing on concrete for long hours and wet or uneven surfaces   
 Standing/walking on concrete surfaces for 10+ hour shifts 
 Working at heights (as   stated   previously)   
 Pushing/pulling wheeled equipment and carts up to 100+ pounds   
 Maneuvering awkward or bulky equipment parts   
 Working in cramped positions under/behind machinery

Our platform helps enterprise pharma companies accelerate innovation, optimize operations, and make manufacturing smarter and more resilient. We’re backed by top-tier investors from Boston, New York, and the Bay Area and are building a world-class team to scale our impact globally.

We’re hiring an growth-oriented, results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to serve as a key engine of our sales team. You will work hand-in-hand with Account Executives to convert strategic leads into qualified sales opportunities and accelerate revenue growth.

 1. Active Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation
 Target key decision-makers across prioritized enterprise pharmaceutical, chemicals, and personal care accounts and manufacturing hubs.

 Webinars: Execute outbound invite campaigns and conduct rapid post-webinar follow-ups to convert warm leads.

 Partner closely with Account Executives to align on account penetration strategies and pipeline velocity.

 Consistently meeting or exceeding targets for qualified discovery meetings booked and pipeline generated.
 Achieving high response and conversion rates through compelling, tailored outreach to enterprise pharma leaders.
 Strong collaborative execution with Account Executives to advance target accounts through the sales funnel.
 1–3 years of experience in tech sales, business development (SDR/BDR), or outbound customer-facing roles.
 Proven track record of building outbound pipeline and engaging decision-makers in B2B software (pharma or industrial tech experience is a plus).
 Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a strong phone and video presence.
 High energy, resilience, and a proactive mindset driven by achieving goals.
 Strong organizational skills and familiarity with sales technology tools (Sales Navigator, CRMs, sales engagement platforms).

 Join a mission-driven startup transforming pharmaceutical manufacturing.
 Work closely with founders, enterprise clients, and experienced sales leaders.
 Fast-track your career trajectory in enterprise SaaS and AI sales.

Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences.

Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel.

We’re building a future where customer experiences are being redefined from support tickets and hold music to faster resolutions, richer conversations, and deeper relationships. We’re proud to be backed by world-class investors who share that vision, including a16z, Accel, Bain Capital Ventures, Coatue, and Index Ventures, along with many others.

We’re an in-office company, driven by a shared commitment to excellence and velocity. Our values — Just Get It Done, Invent What Customers Want, Winner’s Mindset, and The Polymath Principle — shape how we work and grow as a team.



About the Team

Over the past few years, development of LLMs has evolved at a rapid pace. It’s not enough for our customers to just “set it and forget it” when it comes to AI software. Truly successful AI Agents require hands-on execution, rigorous iteration, and deep technical delivery to reach enterprise-grade performance.

We’re creating an Agent Deployment Engineering Org: a specialized technical delivery team responsible for end-to-end execution of AI agent builds. Agent Deployment Engineers own the hands-on work required to deliver best-in-class agents—writing and configuring key components, validating integrations, and ensuring agents perform reliably at scale. This team brings greater specialization and focus to build quality. Agent Deployment Engineers are technical and customer-facing: you’ll interface with senior technical stakeholders on the customer side while also going deep on agent configuration and build execution.

 

About the Role

As an Agent Deployment Engineer, you will be responsible for end-to-end execution of AI agent builds for strategic customers. This is a highly technical delivery role where you will own the implementation work required to launch and scale enterprise-quality agents—partnering with customers and internal teams to define success, translate requirements into build plans, and deliver agents that meaningfully impact the customer’s business.

You’ll work closely with Agent PMs, Agent Success, Engineering, and GTM teams to create tight feedback loops: executing builds, surfacing gaps, and influencing the evolution of Decagon’s agent-building platform based on real customer needs. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in fast-moving environments, enjoys shipping customer-facing technical work, and can balance hands-on execution with structured thinking.

 

In this role, you will

 - Own end-to-end architecture and execution of AI agent builds for enterprise customers, from systems design and initial scoping through implementation, evaluation, and production deployment.

 - Design and engineer the core agentic logic governing agent behavior, applying engineering principles to optimize quality, reliability, and correctness across non-deterministic model outputs.

 - Engineer and validate layered guardrails and supervisory controls to ensure safe, compliant, and predictable agent performance across real-world scenarios.

 - Architect, build, and test integrations with customer systems (e.g., data pipelines, CRMs, ticketing systems), including building the tools, APIs, and workflows needed for reliable deployments at scale.

 - Interface with senior technical stakeholders at customers to define success criteria and system requirements, and drive technical delivery against timelines.

 - Diagnose, debug, and resolve both probabilistic and technical failures through root-cause analysis of execution traces, error logs, and model behavior.

 - Design evaluation and regression-testing frameworks to validate agent behavior against ground truth and guard against performance drift.

 - Translate customer needs into clear internal documentation and run tight feedback loops with Engineering to drive platform improvements.

 - Partner closely with APMs, Engineering, Design, and Go-To-Market teams to deliver consistent, repeatable, best-in-class agent builds.

 

Your background looks something like this

 - Have 5+ years of relevant experience in a technical customer-facing role (e.g., solutions engineering, forward-deployed engineering, technical consulting, implementation engineering, technical product/PM, or similar).

 - Native or business-level fluency in both written and spoken English and Spanish is required.

 - Strong technical foundation: comfortable writing code, working with APIs, and building/validating integrations end-to-end.
   
   Experience delivering production-grade customer solutions that require structured execution, testing/validation, and iteration.

 - Ability to communicate clearly with senior technical stakeholders, translate requirements into implementation plans, and drive delivery.

 - Comfort working in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where you shape solutions as much as you implement them.

 

Even better if you have

 - Experience building with or around LLMs / AI agents (prompting, evaluation, guardrails, tooling, workflow design, etc.).

 - Experience with enterprise SaaS integrations (e.g., ticketing systems, CRM, data pipelines) and associated security/compliance considerations.

 - A Computer Science, Engineering, or Math degree, or equivalent technical experience.

 - Strong product instinct: ability to write crisp PRDs, define success metrics, and contribute customer insight back into product roadmap.



Benefits

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life Insurance and Disability Benefits

 - Retirement Plan (e.g., 401K, pension)

Sadie is building technology for hospitality.
 We're looking for an account executive to win new restaurant customers around major cities in Canada, and to run every deal yourself from the first lead to the signed agreement.
 This is a field role. You'll find restaurants through outbound outreach, networking and on-site visits, then meet owners in person and show them Sadie working on their own calls. You'll work with onboarding and customer success, so that what you sell goes live well. You'll carry monthly and quarterly targets and own the forecast behind them.
 You decide where to spend your time and which deals to pursue, within agreed pricing and terms. AI should be part of how you work. Use it to research restaurants before a visit, prepare demos, draft proposals and follow-ups, and plan your territory. You're responsible for the quality of everything that goes out under your name.
 What we value
 Sound judgement about which deals are real.
 Taking responsibility for your number and finishing work without being chased.
 Understanding how a restaurant makes money, and caring whether Sadie improves it.
 Curiosity about why a deal was lost, and a willingness to change your approach.
 The honesty to say a deal is slipping before the forecast says it for you.
 What you'll do
 Win new restaurants, from first visit to signed agreement 
 Most of your time goes on live deals, and most of those deals happen in person. You'll sit down with owners and general managers in their restaurants to learn how the phone is handled today: who answers it, what gets missed during service, and what those missed calls cost in bookings and orders. Then you'll demo Sadie against that picture.
 You'll scope what the restaurant needs, write the proposal, negotiate terms and get the agreement signed. 
 Most of the judgement is in qualification. A good demo with someone who can't sign, or a restaurant Sadie can't serve yet, costs you weeks. You're expected to spot that early and move on.
 Build your own pipeline across your territory 
 You'll generate your own leads through outbound outreach, networking and on-site visits. That means planning which neighbourhoods and restaurant groups to work, walking in at the right time of day, and following up until you get a meeting.
 Hit your targets with a forecast you can defend 
 You're measured against monthly and quarterly sales targets, and the expectation is that you hit them consistently. You'll keep every opportunity accurate in HubSpot, so that stage, value and close date mean something to the people who plan around them.
 Represent Sadie where restaurant people meet 
 You'll attend local industry events, restaurant meetups and trade shows across your geography. You'll decide which ones are worth the evening, run the conversations there, and turn them into meetings within the week.
 For a lot of operators, you'll be the first person from Sadie they meet. What they hear from you is what they'll repeat to other owners.
 Hand over accounts that go live well 
 The restaurant buys Sadie, but the guest ringing to book a table decides whether it works. You'll give onboarding and customer success a written record of what you promised, what the owner expects, and what could go wrong.
 If you oversell, the owner finds out on a Friday night and the guest pays for it. Set expectations you can stand behind.
 What you'll bring
 At least 2 years in a closing sales role, selling software or services to businesses.
 A record of meeting targets, and the ability to explain how you did it.
 Experience running the whole cycle yourself, from prospecting through to signature.
 Comfort with in-person selling, including cold visits and demos in front of a busy owner.
 Strong discovery skills. You can find out what an operator needs in fifteen minutes between services.
 Clear written communication. Your proposals and follow-ups are accurate and short.
 An honest forecast. You'd rather call a deal lost than carry it for another month.
 You use AI every day for research, preparation and drafting, and you check what it produces.
 You organise your own week across a territory and follow through without being managed.
 Useful experience
 Selling to restaurants or other hospitality operators.
 Working in a restaurant yourself, front of house or in management.
 Selling reservations, POS, telephony or other restaurant technology.
 An existing network among restaurant owners in your territory.
 Selling AI products to non-technical buyers.
 Being an early sales hire at a startup.
 Who will enjoy this role
 You like finding out how a business really works. When an owner says they miss calls at seven on a Saturday, you want to know how many, what those calls were for, and what happened to the guest who hung up.
 In a single week you might walk into six restaurants before lunch service, run a demo at a bar between shifts, spend an evening at a trade show, and sit with onboarding to sort out an account you signed. Your schedule follows the restaurant day, and some of your best conversations will happen at three in the afternoon or late at night.
 The hard parts are specific. Owners are busy and sceptical, and many will turn you away mid-service. You'll hear no far more often than yes, and you'll still need to be back through the next door the same afternoon. Some of the material you'd expect to have, such as local case studies or a settled playbook, may not exist yet, and you'll help build it while carrying a number.
 Why this role matters
 Sadie is building technology for hospitality. Restaurants lose revenue to calls nobody picks up, and our product exists to answer them.
 This role is how Sadie reaches the restaurants in your geography. You decide who to visit and how each customer starts. The agreements you sign affect revenue, what onboarding and customer success inherit, and what a guest hears when they ring to book a table.
 You'll own new restaurant business across your territory, with the authority to decide how Sadie wins it.
 #Sadie

 Requirements

 Combat & Encounter Design 
 Build and balance bosses and enemies in Unreal Engine, with ownership of at least two combat characters or equivalent systems.
 Design attacks end to end, including animation hookup, hitbox timing, cancel windows, hit reactions, i-frames, and telegraphs.
 Increase combat variety and improve the overall combat experience through hands-on iteration and balancing.
 Animation & Combat Feel 
 Apply strong animation principles around weight, timing, anticipation, and readability to create responsive, impactful combat.
 Author or modify animations in Maya, MotionBuilder, Blender, or similar tools and integrate them into gameplay.
 Diagnose combat and animation issues using concepts such as frame data, startup/active/recovery, hitstop, input buffering, and cancel windows.
 Unreal Implementation

 Use Niagara to prototype combat effects and visual feedback.
 Collaborate with engineering, animation, VFX, and design teams to troubleshoot and iterate on gameplay.

 5+ years of experience designing and implementing combat for video games, including ownership of 2+ combat characters or equivalent systems.
 Strong understanding of animation principles and combat feel, with the ability to identify why an attack doesn't land, read, or feel as intended.
 Hands-on Unreal Engine experience with Blueprints, Behavior Trees, Animation Blueprints, and related animation systems.
 Experience with third-person combat, fighting games, shooters, or other combat-focused titles.
 Ability to author or modify animation using Maya, MotionBuilder, Blender, or similar tools.

 Basic C++ knowledge and comfort using AI-assisted coding tools to support gameplay implementation.
 Ability to work independently, take ownership of craft, and drive problems to solutions.

 Experience with Niagara and gameplay VFX prototyping.
 Experience working in a co-development or external development environment.

Who we are
 Unit8, founded in 2017, is a high-tech, dynamic Swiss leader in AI and data analytics consulting, renowned for solving complex challenges in non-digital native industries such as automotive, chemicals, financial services, manufacturing, and pharma. Our partnerships with industry leaders like Palantir, NVIDIA, and OpenAI underscore our commitment to excellence. With over 200 successful projects and a team of ~200 professionals across Switzerland, Poland, Germany, Spain and the US, we have entered the Canadian market in early 2026 and are set for further expansion.
 Our mission
 Unit8 is dedicated to driving AI adoption in non-digital industries and accelerating their digital transformation. We invest in projects that matter, including pro-bono initiatives and “engineering for good” causes.
 The opportunity
 Following our growth in Europe and our recent expansion into the US market in early 2026, Unit8 is taking its next strategic step in North America. We are looking for an entrepreneurially minded Senior Data & AI Consultant / Consulting Lead to help expandestablish our Canadian presence in Montréal.
 This is, above all, a translator role. You are the person who sits with a client's leadership, understands what actually drives their business, and turns ambiguous problems into data & AI opportunities our engineers and data scientists can build. You are the bridge between the boardroom and the build, fluent enough in both to keep them aligned from first conversation to delivered value.
 You own the delivery and transformation strategy. You propose how to bring value across the full journey, from an initial idea and analysis through to large-scale transformation, and you are a strong communicator who can sell that plan and vision to C-level executives.
 As one of our first Canadian hires, you will help shape how the practice operates, which clients we pursue, and what Unit8 becomes known for in Canada.
 What you'll do
 Your role will evolve with our clients' needs and our growth in the region. In general, you will:
 Act as the bridge between business and technology, listening for the client's real pain points and framing them as data & AI opportunities that create measurable value
 Identify and prioritise the use cases across analytics, generative, and agentic AI that genuinely move the needle, from strategy through to implementation
 Build the business case for data & AI investments, quantifying ROI, costs, and benefits so client leaders can make confident decisions
 Shape data & AI strategies and pragmatic roadmaps that align with the client's broader business strategy and priorities
 Design the target operating models that determine how data & AI teams, functions, and centres of excellence work
 Support process re-engineering: rethinking how core business processes should work once data & AI is embedded, and helping clients manage the change
 Guide clients on their journey to becoming data- and AI-driven, assessing their maturity and keeping the work anchored to business outcomes
 Own the solution like a product manager, defining what “good” looks like, keeping scope honest, and holding the team accountable to the value delivered
 Team up with our data engineers, data scientists, AI engineers, and solution architects to turn use cases into working solutions, from modern data platforms and analytics products to machine learning and AI applications
 Contribute to business development by preparing for and taking part in client conversations, workshops, and industry conferences
 Support thought leadership through white papers and industry content on data science & AI
 Who you are
 Above all, you are a consultant and a translator: someone who can hold a business conversation with senior stakeholders and a technical conversation with engineers, and carry meaning cleanly between the two. Specifically, you are:
 A trained business consultant. You built your foundation in a leading management, strategy, or business consultancy (for example a Big 4 firm, Accenture, Capgemini, or a top strategy house), with at least 2 to 3 years of genuine business consulting project experience where you learned to structure ambiguity and drive to outcomes. This is typically part of a broader career of several years.
 A natural translator. You can sit with business leaders, understand their priorities and constraints, and reframe them as data & AI opportunities, then explain the resulting solution back to the business in plain, convincing language.
 Experienced in product management. You have owned a product, solution, or roadmap and been accountable for the value it delivered, coordinating across business and technical teams to get there.
 Seasoned on strategy projects. You have worked on the strategic questions that surround data & AI: building business cases and ROI models, designing operating models, and re-engineering business processes.
 Literate and curious about data & AI. You don't need to build the models, but you understand what modern analytics, GenAI, and agentic AI make possible, and you can spot where they create real value.
 Comfortable with ambiguity. You quickly find the things that matter to a client, whether mid-project or in a business development conversation, and you exercise good judgement on where to focus.
 A relationship builder. You earn the trust of clients and teammates and build partnerships that last.
 Academically grounded. You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, engineering, IT/computer science, mathematics, natural sciences, or a related field; an MBA is welcome.

 Unit8 operates as one international team across Switzerland, Poland, Germany, and now North America, and works with global clients; our day-to-day working language across the company and on delivery teams is therefore English, and professional fluency in English is required for this role. French is a strong asset and is valued for working with Québec-based clients and colleagues, but it is not a requirement.

 At Unit8, we don't just turn data into value; we empower the people who make it possible. If you are looking for a place where you can take ownership, your next chapter starts here.
 A groundbreaking opportunity and footprint. As one of our first Canadian hires, you will play a pivotal role in establishing Unit8's presence in an emerging market, shaping how the practice operates, which clients we target, and what we are known for in Canada.
 Pioneering autonomy. We offer the freedom and entrepreneurial ownership to drive our growth strategy and decide how we deliver maximum value in a new geography.
 High-stakes work. You will work on critical projects that transform how major industries operate.
 A “builder” culture. Our consultants work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers and data scientists who ship production systems. You'll close the loop between strategy and delivery

ABOUT PHOENIX


Founded in 2019, Phoenix is building the most trusted telehealth platform in Canada, making specialist healthcare accessible to every Canadian, wherever they are. Our platform breaks down barriers to care, empowering patients to take control of their health with personalized treatment options and the guidance of licensed providers.

If you thrive where big ideas turn into real impact, you'll fit right in here. We're a team of creative problem-solvers who move deliberately and collaborate in person, because we think the best work happens that way. At Phoenix, you'll find autonomy over your work, people who care about each other's success, and a mission that's making healthcare better for Canadians.




À PROPOS DE PHOENIX


Fondée en 2019, Phoenix bâtit la plateforme de télésanté la plus fiable au Canada, avec la mission de rendre les soins spécialisés accessibles à toute la population canadienne, peu importe où elle se trouve. Notre plateforme fait tomber les obstacles à l'accès aux soins et permet aux patients de prendre leur santé en main, grâce à des traitements personnalisés et à l'accompagnement de professionnels de la santé autorisés.

Si vous aimez voir les grandes idées se transformer en résultats concrets, vous allez vous plaire ici. Nous sommes une équipe de gens créatifs qui aiment résoudre des problèmes, qui avancent de façon réfléchie et qui travaillent ensemble en personne, parce que nous croyons que c'est comme ça que le meilleur travail se fait. Chez Phoenix, vous aurez de l'autonomie dans votre travail, des collègues qui tiennent au succès des autres, et une mission qui améliore concrètement les soins de santé au pays.

Votre rôle


Nous sommes une entreprise de télésanté qui met en relation des patients avec des professionnels de la santé autorisés, par l'intermédiaire d'une plateforme en ligne sécurisée et asynchrone. Nous recherchons une personne titulaire d'un permis d'IPS pour évaluer les demandes des patients, déterminer leur admissibilité au traitement et rédiger des ordonnances lorsque cela est cliniquement indiqué, sans aucune rencontre vidéo ou téléphonique en temps réel.




À PROPOS DE LA PLATEFORME

Les patients remplissent un questionnaire médical guidé qui couvre leurs antécédents. Vous examinez chaque dossier, généralement en moins de cinq minutes, puis vous déterminez la suite : approuver le traitement, demander des renseignements supplémentaires ou refuser. Toutes les communications avec les patients passent par la messagerie sécurisée intégrée à la plateforme.




PROBLÈMES DE SANTÉ ACTUELLEMENT TRAITÉS

 - Gestion du poids

 - Santé sexuelle (dysfonction érectile, éjaculation précoce)

 - Perte de cheveux

 - Hormonothérapie (testostérone)
   
   


RESPONSABILITÉS

 - Examiner les antécédents médicaux transmis par les patients et déterminer leur admissibilité au traitement

 - Rédiger les ordonnances lorsque cela est cliniquement indiqué, ou faire un suivi directement auprès des patients pour obtenir des renseignements supplémentaires

 - Communiquer avec les patients par messagerie sécurisée, au besoin

 - Collaborer avec les équipes clinique et produit afin d'améliorer les processus

 - Signaler les irritants dans l'expérience des patients ou des professionnels de la santé et travailler avec les équipes Expérience client, Produit et Développement pour les régler

 - Apporter un point de vue clinique sur les nouveaux problèmes de santé traités, les nouveaux protocoles et les lancements de produits, à mesure que la plateforme évolue
   


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Être membre en règle de l'Ordre des infirmières et infirmiers du Québec (OIIQ) et détenir un certificat de spécialiste en soins de première ligne, avec admissibilité à un permis d'exercice dans d'autres provinces canadiennes (accompagnement offert pour l'obtention des permis, au besoin)

 - Aisance à travailler au sein d'une plateforme de soins numérique

 - Excellente communication écrite et capacité à travailler efficacement dans un environnement asynchrone, à rythme soutenu

 - Réactivité et empathie dans les interactions avec les patients

 - Intérêt à collaborer avec des équipes non cliniques

 - Expérience en santé des hommes, un atout
   


À QUOI S'ATTENDRE

 - Aucune rencontre en temps réel. Toutes les interactions avec les patients sont asynchrones : aucun appel ni aucune visioconférence à l'horaire.

 - Aucune facturation aux assureurs. Les patients paient directement : ni paperasse d'assurance, ni traitement de réclamations.

 - Assurance responsabilité professionnelle. Votre protection actuelle (assurance collective de l'OIIQ et adhésion à la SPIIC) s'applique ; aucune couverture supplémentaire n'est exigée.

 - Le travail clinique se fait entièrement à distance: aucun déplacement n'est requis pour ce rôle. Ce sont les équipes internes (Produit, Ingénierie, Opérations, Marketing, etc.) qui se réunissent à nos bureaux de Toronto pour la planification, la rétroaction et la résolution de problèmes.




WHY WORK AT PHOENIX?

 - A Rewarding Mission: Through our asynchronous care model, Phoenix is reimagining patient-centric care for Canadians across the country by making diagnoses and treatment delivery faster, more accessible, and completely discreet.
   

 - Impact & Autonomy: You’ll work directly with passionate, experienced leaders who’ve seen the ups and downs of building a business and genuinely care about your growth. You won’t just execute — you’ll help shape the future of Phoenix and Raven.
   

 - Collaborative On-Site Culture: Our Operations, Product, Engineering, and Marketing teams work together on-site from our downtown Toronto HQ. We thrive on quick feedback loops, spontaneous brainstorms, and actually knowing the people we work with. Bonus points if you're into the occasional foosball tournament or have strong opinions about the best lunch spot nearby.
   

 - Clinical Excellence: All Phoenix & Raven telehealth clinicians work remotely, providing the highest quality care for even the most sensitive of health topics. Medications are delivered directly (and discreetly) to patients via our pharmacy warehouses, where our diligent Pharmacy team packages each treatment with care.
   

 - Competitive Pay, Real Benefits: Our compensation bands are backed by real market data, so offers are competitive and fair. Our benefits package includes standard healthcare coverage, a remote-first holiday season, and holistic wellbeing support for when life just happens.

 An overview of this role 
 As a Staff Renewals Operations Manager at GitLab, you'll help own the operational engine that makes renewals predictable, measurable, and efficient at scale. Reporting to the Director of CX Operations, you'll be the Renewals team's go-to business partner for processes, tooling, forecasting and insights, consumption and subscription data, and the steps required to quote and close a renewal. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. You'll lead through ownership and influence, connecting teams and workflows, turning ambiguous problems into clear next steps, and driving improvements that others across the revenue organization depend on.
 What you'll do 
 Own and continuously improve the end-to-end renewal operating model; from renewal identification, assignment through risk management, quoting, through to close and post-renewal data hygiene processes.
 Develop and improve the operating cadences that guide the renewal business, with a focus on efficiency and process improvement.
 Define, maintain, and evolve retention reporting with cross-functional partners, including gross and net retention, churn and downgrade analysis, and the drivers behind each.
 Partner with Revenue Technology, Revenue Analytics, Finance, and other stakeholders to improve Salesforce and the systems and data flows supporting customer relationship management (CRM), subscription and entitlement records, quoting, orders, billing, and reporting. Translate business needs into requirements, validate solutions, and strengthen data quality and operational controls.
 Simplify and scale the renewal motion through automation, standardized workflows, alerts, playbooks, and self-service insights that reduce manual effort and improve execution consistency.
 Support renewals planning and capacity management, including segmentation implementation, coverage models, productivity assumptions, capacity modeling, supporting target setting, and scenario planning.
 Own and mature the Renewal Operations case-management program, including intake, triage, routing, service-level visibility, resolution, and root-cause analysis. Requests may include user migrations, de-duplication, Renewal Manager ownership changes, compensation exceptions, and Salesforce or data issues.
 Raise the operating standard in your domain by documenting processes, mentoring others on how the renewal motion works, and contributing to broader Revenue Operations initiatives that need the renewals perspective.
 What you'll bring 
 Experience in Renewals Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, management consulting, strategy, or a similar analytical and problem-solving role, with ownership of operational improvements and cross-functional initiatives.
 Hands-on experience with both consumption and subscription renewal motions, including renewal forecasting, retention reporting, and the contractual and process mechanics that govern how renewals close.
 Strong critical thinking and structured problem-solving skills. You can break down ambiguous problems into clear workstreams and move them forward.
 Strong quantitative and analytical skills. You're highly proficient in Excel or Google Sheets, can build and validate models from scratch, and can translate analysis into clear recommendations and action. Experience with Structured Query Language (SQL) or equivalent data-querying tools is preferred, not required.
 Systems thinking and experience using Salesforce for pipeline and renewals reporting. You understand how changes in one part of the go-to-market motion affect others, including how CRM, subscription or entitlement records, quoting, and billing relate to one another, and you design solutions accordingly.
 Sound commercial judgment and an understanding of renewal complexity, including co-terming, amendments, expansions, downgrades, price changes, multiyear agreements, auto-renewals, procurement requirements, and approval policies.
 Strong cross-functional collaboration skills. You build trust with stakeholders at all levels, including field teams and senior leadership, and influence without direct authority.
 Curiosity, sound judgment, and a bias toward action. You learn new domains and tools quickly, move from insight to implementation, and follow through until improvements are adopted and sustained.
 About the team 
 You'll work within CX Operations, partnering closely with Renewals and Customer Success leadership, Sales, Finance, Revenue Technology, and Revenue Analytics. La lutte contre le changement climatique est une priorité mondiale. En tant qu’entreprise dont la technologie est utilisée pour alimenter environ 25 % de l’électricité dans le monde, nous prenons notre responsabilité au sérieux. GE Vernova est une entreprise qui prend part à une nouvelle ère énergétique – électrifiant le monde tout en travaillant à le décarboniser. Nous accélérons la transition vers une énergie plus fiable, abordable et durable, tout en aidant nos clients à alimenter des économies et à fournir l'électricité essentielle à la santé, à la sûreté, à la sécurité et à l'amélioration de la qualité de vie.
L'activité Hydroélectrique de GE Vernova conçoit, développe, fabrique et entretient des technologies avancées qui exploitent la puissance de l'eau pour fournir une énergie fiable et durable. Depuis plus d’un siècle, l’hydroélectricité joue un rôle essentiel dans les systèmes électriques nord-américains et mondiaux. Aujourd’hui, il s’agit de la plus grande source d’énergie renouvelable au monde, et la technologie pompage-turbinage représenta la plus grande source de stockage d’énergie. Mais pour atteindre zéro émission nette à l’échelle mondiale d’ici 2050, nous devons doubler la quantité d’hydroélectricité existante. Que ce soit par pompage-turbinage, au fil de l’eau ou en mettant à niveau la base installée existante, l’hydroélectricité continuera d’être la pierre angulaire de l’avenir énergétique de l’Amérique du Nord.
Avez-vous l'énergie pour changer le monde ? Si vous êtes prêt à faire la différence et à entrer dans la nouvelle ère énergétique, rejoignez-nous. Vous aurez l'opportunité d'évoluer et de grandir parmi les esprits les plus brillants du secteur, de travailler sur des technologies de pointe et de faire partie d'une équipe mondiale d'environ 75 000 personnes réparties dans plus de 100 pays.

Addressing the climate crisis is an urgent global priority. As a company whose technology is used to power ~25% of the world’s electricity, we take our responsibility seriously.
